purpose: Prosecute Mechanicus six-gate baseline closure by checking identity, functions, capability evidence, personal validators, current truth/receipts, residency/trust, and forbidden overclaims.
rules: Custodes must validate Mechanicus claims against machine-readable reports, receipts and indices, not narrative alone.
Custodes may accept six-gate baseline prosecution only if all six gates are PASS_BASELINE and supported by reports/receipts.
Custodes must reject any Mechanicus claim of full assembly, Throne crown, real execution safety, local model readiness or universal reproducibility.
Custodes must verify current truth is indexed and non-current residents are classified.
Custodes prosecution does not replace Throne crown verdict and must not claim final organ assembly.
pass_meaning: Custodes baseline prosecution accepts that Mechanicus six gates are baseline-closed and evidence-bound without granting Throne crown or full organ assembly.
